changes: Separate bounded observer history from pending endpoint deliveries, preventing duplicated network reports and retaining delivered reports for buffered observation.
Preserve queued observer notifications after disconnect and keep buffered snapshots traced on their owning script thread.
Make registration idempotent and release the worker observer-list read borrow before removal.
Parse Reporting-Endpoints as one structured dictionary, including quoted delimiters, parameters, repeated fields, duplicate names and trustworthy destination origins.
Prepare independent enforced/report-only Permissions Policy state, inheritance and response-local endpoint selection. DOM report generation is a separate remaining step.
scope: Local reporting fixtures use private temporary profiles, session buses and compositors.
Worker disconnection crash is fixed in the scoped regression; this is not a claim that all browser crashes are resolved.
Public pages are anonymous survival/closure samples, not whole-site rendering conformance tests. The accepted X QR overlap remains a non-bug.
XR checks use a synthetic private DomeD host, not a physical headset.
Permissions Policy observer bodies and WebXR report emission are not implemented in this checkpoint. The original two XR reporting WPT cases are not claimed to pass.
The Reporting dictionary / Permissions Policy legacy interface mismatch and mixed-type/document lifecycle tests remain for the typed report-body integration.

retained_failed_runs.result: Buffered report snapshots cannot be captured by sendable tasks; corrected to keep snapshots traced on the observer and queue only Trusted handles and indices.
Trustworthiness check corrected to inspect destination origin.
CSP event timing assumption corrected before candidate runtime validation; old disconnect/takeRecords timings are not conformance evidence.
uv environment lacked system dbus-python; rerun with the system interpreter passed.
